description: Who is signed in on Gymmy: answers 'what is my Gymmy account', 'which gym am I connected to', 'what's my email', 'what's my name' or 'what's my member id'. Returns the account name, email, member id, membership status (plan and active, unpaid, paused, or coach/admin) and every linked gym with address, city, country, phone, public email, website, maps link, logo, opening hours and listing URL. A test gym hidden from the public directory is still included when it is this member's gym. If the person is not signed in, the answer asks them to connect: the sign-in page accepts an email code for an existing account or creates a Gymmy account. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinates (geo), mapsUrl (Google Maps), directionsUrl, appleMapsUrl, logoUrl (the salle logo or a sourced photo, null when there is none), listingUrl (public page, null when the gym is not public), phone, public email, website and opening hours, and null for anything Gymmy does not have. gym, classId and memberId are internal ids, used as arguments of other Gymmy tools.

locale.description: Answer language: fr (default), en, pt, es or de. Pass en when the person writes in English.

name: get_my_account

email.description: The signed-in email. You may tell the user this.

gyms.description: Linked gyms. memberId and gym are internal ids.

items.description: A gym. `gym` is its internal id, used as an argument of other Gymmy tools.

address.description: Full postal address (street, postcode, city, country). Null when unknown.

appleMapsUrl.description: Apple Maps URL for the same place.

country.description: Country, ISO alpha-2 when the gym stored one (FR, PT…).

directionsUrl.description: Google Maps directions URL to the gym.

email.description: Public contact email of the gym. Not a member email.

listingUrl.description: Public listing or published gym page. Null when the gym is not public.

logoUrl.description: Salle logo or sourced photo. Null when the gym has none. Never invent one.

mapsUrl.description: Google Maps search URL built from coordinates, or from the address.

openingHours.description: Opening hours in one line, when known.

phone.description: Public phone. Null when the gym has not published one.

styles.description: Yoga or pilates style ids (bikram, vinyasa, hatha, yin, reformer, lagree, …). The discipline stays in activities.

name.description: The person's name. Null when Gymmy has none. You may tell the user this.

title: My Gymmy account
